summary: Updates the SCTP specification in RFC 4960 with a way for a sender to ask for an immediate Selective Acknowledgment, using an Immediate bit in the DATA chunk header. Since unknown flags are ignored, it is compatible with older implementations. It was replaced by RFC 9260.

eli5.summary: A sender can tap a flag meaning please tell me right now that you got this, instead of waiting.

questions: immediate bit in sctp data chunk
how to avoid delayed acks in sctp
